outcome: immediate adverse reactions (fever, headache, early adverse events)
severity of adverse reactions (mild, moderate, severe)
cohort: The study included 109 patients with primary immune deficiency (PID), comprising 32 girls and 77 boys with a mean age of 11.8 years.
finding: In this cohort, PID patients experienced mostly mild immediate adverse events to IVIG infusions, with primary antibody deficiency (PAD) being associated with an increased risk of adverse events.
